    Homemade Pumpkin Spice Syrup

    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 3:20
    Instaread

    Published: Sep 28, 2026 · by Natalie · This post may contain affiliate links. Please read our privacy policy. ·

    RECIPE PIN

    You’ll love this homemade pumpkin spice syrup. Made with real pumpkin and warm spices, it’s perfect for coffee, oatmeal, cocktails, and more.

    Yes, you can go buy a syrup to pour into your coffee. What's in it? Can you pronounce the ingredients? When you taste it, does it have that weird aftertaste?

    How about making your own? It takes less than 10 minutes. It’s super easy too.

    If I’m going to make something with spice in the title, I’m going to make sure it has spice in it. For the amount of liquid in the recipe, I use a good amount of the spices. You might as well taste it right? Otherwise, it’s just sweet syrup.

    Sweeten the pumpkin spice syrup to your liking

    About the amount of sweetness, I don’t add a ton of sugar. You can add more to your liking in your coffee. I like my coffee black with no sugar, yet this was perfect. Maybe too perfect, as I had more coffee than I should have and was up all night.

    There is an order to make pumpkin spice syrup

    Cook the pumpkin to get rid of that raw, metallic taste, and then add and warm up the spices so they can really blend into the pumpkin and sugar before adding the liquid.

    First, mix the pumpkin puree and the brown sugar in a small saucepan over medium heat.

    Add the spices and stir it until combined. We want to heat up the spices to wake them up.

    Stir in the maple syrup then slowly add in the water. Cook on medium heat for five minutes. 

    Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla.

    Let it cool. Store in your favorite container.

    That’s it.

    This is absolutely incredible added to oatmeal - and I mean incredible!

    Easy, right?

    Make it. 

    This recipe can absolutely be doubled. 

    Life is too short for mediocre food.

    Homemade Pumpkin Spice Syrup

    PRINT RECIPE PIN RECIPE SAVE RECIPESaved!

    Please Rate This Recipe

    If you tried this recipe, please leave a star rating and comment below. Thank you!

    If you love pumpkin, you’ll love this pumpkin spice syrup. This has all the flavors of fall and can be used as a flavoring for your coffee, added to oatmeal, or even for making an interesting cocktail. Makes about 1 ½ cups. This recipe can be doubled.
    Author: Natalie Gregory

    Ingredients

    • ½ cup pumpkin puree I use Libby's
    • ¼ cup brown sugar
    • 1 ½ teaspoons cinnamon
    • 1 teaspoon ground ginger
    • ¼ teaspoon nutmeg
    • ¼ teaspoon ground cloves
    • ¼ teaspoon allspice
    • ¼ teaspoon ground cardamom
    • Pinch of salt
    • ½ cup pure maple syrup not the fake stuff
    • ½ cup water
    • 1 teaspoon vanilla

    Instructions

    • In a small saucepan over medium heat, stir the pumpkin puree and brown sugar until it comes together.
    • Add the cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, cloves, allspice, cardamom, and salt. We want to wake up the spices.
    • Stir in the maple syrup. Slowly stir in the water. Bring it to a low simmer and let it continue to cook for 5 minutes.
    • Remove from heat and whisk in vanilla.
    • Let it cool, then transfer into jars or a bottle.
    • Stir it in your coffee, tea, add it to oatmeal - which is super delicious - or create an interesting cocktail. Enjoy.
